title: ResearchLedger Claim frontmatter (v2)
description: The YAML frontmatter block of research/claims/C<NNN>.md. v2 canonical form uses real YAML arrays, not comma-delimited strings. Note: `contradicts` holds EVIDENCE ids (the reverse of Evidence.contradicts, which holds claim ids).

status.description: v2 claim states — deliberately disjoint from evidence states. See reference/run-ledger.md#status-vocabulary; a claim is never 'verified', only ever supported by evidence that is.
